section: Hardware Connections
context_before: Parallax offers pre-built P2 boards where vital connections are already made for you.  Examples include the P2 Edge Module (#P2-EC) and P2 Mini Breakout Board (#64019) pictured here.
context_after: Schematics are available for download from the respective product pages.  Visit the Propeller 2 > Hardware section of the Parallax online store for development tools.  For additional P2 connection details including boot options, see the P2 Datasheet in the Documentation section.

section: Cog Memory
context_before: Each cog has its own internal RAM that it uses to execute code and to store and manipulate data independent of every other cog.  This internal RAM is organized into two contiguous blocks of 512 longs (512 x 32), called Register RAM and Lookup RAM, each with special attributes.  See RAM Memory Config
context_after: Note that $1FE (INA) and $1FF (INB) are also the debug interrupt call address and return address, respectively.
